fields.label: Shadow display
fields.value: Blue ground polygons show modeled building shadows for the current sun azimuth and elevation.

fields.label: Calculation
fields.value: Building shade applies when a ray from the walker toward the sun intersects a known-height building prism. Canopy and weather are modeled separately.

fields.label: Environmental evidence
fields.value: Historical 2015 trees + pinned 2024 Central Park analog

fields.label: Claim boundary
fields.value: Deterministic direct-beam exposure using retained buildings, historical 2015 street-tree identities with modeled crown envelopes, and a pinned 2024 Central Park weather analog. It is not current observed street shade, measured irradiance, thermal comfort, or a forecast of present canopy or weather.
